india.one_line: India leads ChatGPT usage while AI wealth startup PowerUp Money raises $10 million.

themes.title: ChatGPT user base doubles in India
themes.text: OpenAI reports India now has the highest weekly active user count for ChatGPT worldwide, with the user base having doubled since January 2026. The company is adding local computing capacity, Indian-language features, Android‑first products, and plans UPI‑related announcements.

stories.headline: India becomes ChatGPT’s largest market by weekly active users, base doubles since Jan 2026

themes.title: PowerUp Money secures $10 million
themes.text: Bengaluru‑based PowerUp Money raised $10 million led by Flourish Ventures to expand its AI‑powered wealth advisory platform and grow its managed advisory service, which serves over 1.5 million users and holds nearly Rs 500 crore in assets under management.

stories.headline: PowerUp Money raises $10 million to expand AI‑led wealth management in India
